# Transcript Compare run fixtures

| File | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `results.golden.json` | For every case, the results file (`SUMMARY`, `DIFF`, `MARKER` lines), the unified diff and the `.manuscript.txt` and `.recorded.txt` pair a run writes, the diff named `run.diff`. Written by `compare.py`'s run before its markers moved to the host (2026-10-24), and reproduced unchanged by `src/studio/desktop/internal/comparerun/golden_test.go`. That Python code is deleted, so the file is regenerated only from Go (`UPDATE_CONTRACTS=1` after an intended change), with no Python to cross-check against. The cases are the recording check's corpus (`../coverage-words.golden.json` over `../coverage/manuscript.json`, each item one segment laid end to end), every take-divergence case in both timings (`../divergence/words.golden.json`, one segment each) and the chapters and takes in `random-cases.json`. |
| `random-cases.json` | Seeded chapters and takes: misreads, skips, extras, restarts, fillers, numbers, homophones, project equivalences, odd paragraph indices, several segments, and four takes of nothing but fillers, so nothing aligns. Each case carries its manuscript, its equivalence list, the chapter, the match score, the segments and the words. |
| `words-report.golden.txt` | The words report `compare.py`'s run writes (`COMPARE_SEGMENT`, `COMPARE_WORDS`), pinned by `tests/test_compare_run.py` and read by the host's `TestTheSidecarsWordsReportReadsAsWritten`. |
